title: Becoming #GenerationRestoration: Ecosystem restoration for people, nature and climate
methodology: Policy synthesis on ecosystem restoration priorities and approaches.
limitations: High-level guidance; local species choice and tenure conditions are not specified.

chunks.text: Restoring connectivity and reversing habitat conversion are central to biodiversity recovery after deforestation and fragmentation. Restoration is not only tree planting; it includes rehabilitating soil, hydrology, and landscape mosaics. Stopping further conversion is a first step because species cannot recolonize habitat that continues to shrink.
